I am %name the %Class.
%name, at your service. I'm a mere apprentice - but I hope to be a powerful warlock one day.
%name, at your service. I'm apprenticed to a sorcerer here.

When I speak the words, the dead rise from their graves, and Daedric beasts bend the knee. I have power, and seek yet more power - for once you've drank from that river of dark knowledge, your thirst cannot easily be slaked.
Don't let my bookish appearance fool you, my friend. I've bartered with demons and forged artifacts of deadly, brilliant power.
I have dedicated myself to mastery of the mystic arts through a regimen of fasting, meditation and breathing exercises.
I am an outcast by choice, shunning my native Hammerfell and the family who spurned me, driven by a burning desire for secret knowledge.
I was sold to a warlock as a child. My knowledge eventually outstripped that of my master. He was careless, and now, dead.
In truth, I would willingly pledge my lifeblood to the Daedra Lords if I stood to gain a snippet of magical lore. Power is the only goal in life - anyone who tells you different is a fool, or a liar.
As a Breton, mystic powers are my birthright. I am driven by visions of my fate, and seek to master all forms of magical lore.
My name is %name. I'm training to be a mage.

I'm a wizard, but I'm not Telvanni - which is something of a rarity here in Vvardenfell. Any magic not Temple magic is thought a bit funny by your common mer at best, and black and evil at worst. All the houses have their mages, of course, and each village will have a hedgewizard or two, but nothing respectable. I keep to myself, mostly - no need in attracting too much attention to my studies.
I spent my youth hunched over tomes while others worked the fields. Now, the mystic arts are mine to command, with all the respect and responsibility that comes with them.
I am %name - master of the arcane arts and traveller of the outer worlds.
I am %name, mage.
I am %name, a merchant. I only do business with select patrons, however.
I am %name, a trader in many wares and curiosities. Shall we strike a deal today?
I am %name, trader and businessman. Shall we strike a deal today?

I am %name, purveyor of the very finest wares. Silks and spices, daggers and diamonds - they've all passed through these old hands. I deal in in very rare and specific goods, and don't trade with the general public. It's nothing personal.
I am %name, purveyor of the very finest wares. Silks and spices, daggers and diamonds - they've all passed through these green hands. I'm not here to do business, however.
I am %name, purveyor of the very finest wares. Silks and spices, daggers and diamonds - they've all passed through these gold hands. I only deal with a select few patrons.

I am %name, purveyor of the very finest wares. Silks and spices, daggers and diamonds - they've all passed through these grey hands. I don't do business with outlanders, however. Call me old fashioned.
I'm in the field of pawnbroking, and business is good. The Great Houses want all kinds of maps and relics these days, though what they want them for, it's not my place to ask.
The wise, the righteous, the mighty - the merchant feeds them all.
%name's the name, pawnbroking my game. Care to do business?

I am a scout and hunter, the best in my tribe - but I want to be the best in the world. The peak of Red Mountain is mighty indeed. With the blessing of the Hist, perhaps I can scale its heights, and prove that I truly am the best.
I can never hold on to gold for very long, %PCName. As soon as I earn it, I plan and outfit my next great expedition. The journey itself, the joy of adventure - that's what I live for.

I have always been fascinated by the distant places of Tamriel. As a child I would spend hours staring at my father's maps and dream of the people and creatures who lived across the sea. Now I travel the roads of Morrowind - where the people are strange indeed, and the creatures stranger still.
l have the wanderlust, and chafe if I remain in one place for any length of time. I enjoy the freedom of the open road and the thought that I never know what adventures each new day will bring.
I prefer to make my bed in mountain grottos and woodland groves rather than the squalid, noisy streets of cities.

I was born and raised in Morrowind, and know the rivers, mountains and roads round here like the back of my hand. You are an outlander. Outlanders don't last long out in the wild. So take a little advice from me, maybe you'll learn something.
I've travelled the open roads, and the hidden passes. They lead to dark places filled with glittering ebony and ancient horrors. Some brave folk ask me how to find these places.
I'm a scout. I know the lie of that land, even in this wild place, where nature has forgotten its own rules.

I can taste when a storm is about to break, that cold moisture in air. Or the dry tickle in the throat, just before the blight blows down on you. A Bosmeri weather sense can be the difference between a good scout and a dead scout here in Morrowind.

Although I was not born here, I have come to know the rivers, mountains and roads of this land well indeed. It is a wild and unforgiving place, and I will share what I have learned of it, if you will listen.
Ser %name, at your service my lady.
Ser %name, at your service.
Please, call me %name - and the honour is all mine. I hope to be a mighty warrior one day, just like you!
I am %name. I hope to be a mighty warrior one day. I keep my blade sharp, and spar whenever I can find a willing teacher.

I am %name. I've killed more men and mer than I can count. In peacetime, there's always mercenary work. When war comes, I thrive. And I've heard of you, %PCName. I hope our blades never cross as enemies.
I am %name. I've killed more men and mer than I can count. In peacetime, there's always mercenary work. When war comes, I thrive.
Many men have mistaken this slender frame for weakness - and ended their lives in a spreading pool of blood. Yet still I wish to perfect my skills so that no one can stand against me.

Many men and mer has mistaken these good looks and manners for foppishness - and ended their lives in a spreading pool of blood. Yet still I wish to perfect my skills so that no one can stand against me.
I hope to write my name in blood across the pages of history - to be remembered in fireside songs as the greatest swordswoman that ever lived.
I hope to write my name in blood across the pages of history - to be remembered in fireside songs as the greatest swordsman that ever lived.
I'm more than a match for any man in a fight. I'm not one to forget a favour, or a slight.
I am blunt and outspoken, it's true - but I scrupulously follow the warrior's code. Defend those who cannot defend themselves, and stand up for what you know is right, no matter what the cost.
I left Valenwood when an extended outbreak of peace and prosperity made my skills redundant there. In Morrowind, there's always work for a hired blade.
I am %name. I seek fame through adventure and the glory of battle.

I'm a beast of iron, living day to day by my armor and the skill of my arm. I love guts, glory and the scream of battle. I hear other so called adventurers moan about their wounds over the tavern fire - but I bear my scars with pride.
My name is %name. I live on what little I have, talk straight and kill without remorse. My past is my own, and I don't care to hear yours. That said and done, what can I do for you?
Call me %name. I know how to fight, and have the scars to prove it.

%name. That's my name. I like breaking things and smashing my foes into bloody pulp. But a big man like yourself doesn't have to be scared of me. I'm sure you can take care of business with all that muscle, can't you?
%name. That's my name. I like breaking things and smashing my foes into bloody pulp. Then a big man to roll in the sack with after the kill.

You stand before %name. I like breaking things and smashing my foes into bloody pulp. But a sweet thing like yourself shouldn't be scared of me. I see you looking at my muscles, %PCName. Don't be shy now.
You stand before %name. I like breaking things and smashing my foes into bloody pulp. Then, a good woman after the kill.

I'm %Name, pleased to meetcha an' all the rest. What can I say? I like to scratch, and belch, and spit. I don't have time for fine manners and story-swapping. Fight me, love me, or stay out of my way, that's what I say.

You stink of the dust and sweat of the city, friend. I walk the old ways, and wear the pelts of the earth itself. The gods of the Dunmer are children, the steel of the Empire is false protection. I sleep rough where I can and follow no laws but the beat of my own wild heart.
I'm just plain old %Name. No sers or seras needed here, %PCRace. So ask your question straight, and if I'm in the mood, I'll answer likewise.
Call me %name. I follow my instinct and ask questions later. Or never. I love to drink, and fight, and laugh. But cross me and I'll hunt you to your grave.

The name's %name. I used to be blademer for a few select patrons. They paid well for my reports, and better for my discretion. Now I make a drake or two in by showing the youngbloods what I know. You interested?
The name's %name. I'm local, can handle myself, and like my privacy. Keep your questions sensible, don't waste my time, and we'll get along fine.

The name's %name. I'm local, can look after myself, and cut the nose off fetchers who poke it where it doesn't belong. But you seem okay, for an outlander. Stick around, might be we can teach each other a thing or two.
The name's %name. I'm local, can look after myself, and cut the nose off fetchers who poke it where it doesn't belong. Just so we're clear.
Spell and shadow have always been my friends. You see %Name only when I wish to be seen. I can show you some of what I know - for a price, of course.
Spell and shadow have always been my friends. You see %Name only when I wish to be seen.

I have a sinister reputation, I suppose. I do close, dirty work - but I do it well. Might be you need to get your hands dirty from time to time too, %PCRace. You got septims to spend? I'll show you some moves your enemies won't see coming.
I have a sinister reputation, I suppose. I do close, dirty work - but I do it well.

Darkness has always attracted me more than harsh daylight. As a child I practised till my footstep was quieter than a spider, my touch lighter than a moth's wing. I see by that look I have your attention. I'm happy to teach you what I know, for a modest fee.

Darkness has always attracted me more than harsh daylight. As a child I practised till my footstep was quieter than a spider, my touch lighter than a moth's wing. No lock or vault is proof against my skills.
The name's %name. I'm quick with a blade, always have been. Might be I could show you a move or two, if you've got the patience, and more importantly, the coin.
The name's %name. I'm quick with a blade, always have been. That's all you need to know.
I am %name. My home is here in Ebonheart.
I am %name. My clan and hearth is here in Vivec.
I am %name. My home is here in Vivec.
I am %name. My clan and hearth is here in Ald-ruhn.
I am %name. My home is here in Ald-ruhn.
I am %name. My clan and hearth is here in Balmora.
I am %name. My home is here in Balmora.
I'm a local, born and raised here.
Yeah, I live here. I'm a good builder by day, and a bad gambler by night.
I'm one of the law-abiding townsfolk round here. That doesn't mean I can't tell you an interesting thing or too though.
Oh, I've lived here for many years. I weave, cook, wash clothes - whatever richer folk don't have the time to do themselves.
I stitch, hunt and herd. Just trying to make a living round here.
I'm just a local Bosmer. I keep my head down and try to make ends meet as best I can.
I've lived here for many years sera. Deep roots with these folk.
I do odd jobs for the locals here. Cleaning the houses of rich Dunmer, cooking at their feasts. It doesn't pay much, but I get by.
I've made my home in Morrowind for quite some time now. Don't think I'll be leaving anytime soon.
I'm just an honest washerwoman. If you're looking for more than clean clothes, I can tell you about our local services.
I've lived here for quite some time. I know the locals, the travellers, the troublemakers round these parts.
I'm a local lass. I've lived here a while, know the townsfolk well. Were you looking for someone in particular?
I'm a local lad. Lived here for years now.
My home and hearth are right here outlander.
I'm no slave, marshsister - but free and living in Morrowind with my head held high.
I'm no slave, marshbrother - but free and living in Morrowind with my head held high.
I'm no slave %PCRace. If the locals want me to work, they have to pay me right - same as anyone else.
I live here as a free Argonian sera - no chains or master for me. A solid roof and a warm fire are all I have, and all I need.
I'm one of the many folk who live round here.
I'm local, born and bred. Unlike yourself.
Yeah, I live round here. What's it to you?
I am %name, a humble slave.
Heads always turn when %name walks into a tavern. I live by my wits and have no care for either the future or the past.
The ladies call me dashing, their husbands - a scoundrel. I live by my wits and have no care for either the future or the past.
I have the agility of a gazelle, the cunning of a fox and the ferocity of an eagle.
I grew up in the backstreets of Anvil. I was forced to flee because I was too.... active in my chosen profession. I've come to Morrowind to seek my fortune.
My enemies call me devious, but I'm just a resourceful kind of f'lah. I can break in - and slip out - of almost anywhere.

That's a long story, sera. Let's just say years of daily struggle with the law, and those of my own trade, have left me jaded and tired. I'm always happy to swap the latest rumors, or a little secret with those I like best though.
%name, at your service. I'm a juggler, firebreather and teller of bad jokes.
Miss %name, at your service. I'm a dancer, and actress whenever I can find the work.
%name, at your service. I'm a juggler, dancer and all round rogue.
I'm an archer. Mostly I'm hired to track down targets for wealthy Dunmer. I've seen service in the legion too, so I know how to shoot to kill if I have to.
I'm a ranger, a scout, an archer. Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, in every river, along every road. You just need to know how to look.
I'm a ranger. I track men and beasts. The former I hunt for gold, the latter for sport.
I can notch an arrow and shoot a man through the throat before he can free his blade from the scabbard. Want me to prove it?
My name is %Name. The thrill of the hunt and the promise of payment - that's what I live for.
Call me %name. I can skewer a caverat at fifty paces with a dagger, and bring down a cliffracer in a blightstorm with my trusty bow. Folks often pay me for it.
I've fallen on hard times, as you can see sera. I'm just trying to make ends meet at the moment.
Me? I'm just %name. Could you spare a drake sera?
I'm like the storm, my friend - swift and powerful. I ride beside nomads, climb among the mountain tribes and sail with sea reavers in my search for gold and glory.
I travel with a blade at my hip and a head full of spells. Cities make me ill - I can only breathe freely on the open road.
I never know my father, and my mother mislaid me among the carts of a slaver's caravan. I escaped to seek my fortune here in Morrowind.
I have explored haunted castles, ruined cities, dank crypts and desolate forests in my constant search for gold and glory.
I travel from place to place, searching for adventure, and an opportunity to hone my deadly arts. I have heard of an unkillable warrior called %PCName, and have a mind to try her mettle.
I travel from place to place, searching for adventure, and an opportunity to hone my deadly arts. I have heard of an unkillable warrior called %PCName, and have a mind to try his mettle.
I was cast out of Cyrodiil for something that no civilized country would regard as a crime. Now I roam these lands in search of a more rugged people to settle among.
I'm a resourceful survivor, with a restless nature that forces me to stay on the move.
I travel from place to place, searching for adventure, and an opportunity to hone my deadly arts. I have heard of an unkillable warrior called Umbra, and have a mind to try her mettle.
I'm %name, a blade for hire. Don't push me unless you enjoy the taste of your own blood.
I always have a sweet song on my lips to charm the people I meet.
One day I would like to play music at the court of King Helseth - a great honour for any travelling minstrel.

I'm a storyteller, sera. Stories and songs can do more than entertain. Properly told, stories can unite a community, allow you to share experiences, and convey lessons and old wisdoms. Likewise, songs can uplift one’s soul and inspire others to perform great deeds, or they can fill one’s heart with despair or dread.
I am trained in reciting the great epics of Dunmer history. But perhaps one day, the troubadours will sing of me as the greatest bard that ever lived.
I took up my haversack and began a life of adventure and minstrelry at a young age. I have not met many people who could not be swayed with deft wit and a silver tongue.

I am a teller-of-tales and singer-of-songs. It takes a mere minstrel to retell a story - but a true bard to live it. You'll find me on the open road with a blade in my hand one day, and by the fireside strumming a lute the next.
I live by my wits sera. Look for me at the tavern firesides, where I love to regale travellers with my tales.
